fields.title: 8. Three data points to verify directly before the next issue
fields.md:
1. **SpaceXAI clause in Anthropic's 424B4**: who may give notice (whether both parties), the end date of the initial term, and the nature of the $120.5 billion cap. Avoiding the size limit requires EDGAR full-text search context or split viewing (source: `state.open_questions_for_next_run`).
2. **Original CNBC interview**: the date and full context — whether the quote answers a question about extension or termination (source: `state.musk_statements_as_milestone_candidates_only`).
3. **Existing checkpoints**: Ariane 64 LE-04 (11/23, T4) · DA 26-1160 reconsideration deadline (11/27, T8) · T7 ⓕ (11/30) · monthly 12/01 · T2 12/8 lock-up · T12 12/9 vote (source: `state.triggers_next_12m`).
